title: Wild Boar in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Meeting one is normal and usually harmless.** City boar are used to people and rarely attack unless they or their young feel threatened.
**Stay calm, keep your distance and always leave the boar a way out.** Never walk it into a fence, a corner or a building.
**Turn back from a sow with striped young.** Never walk between a mother and her piglets.
**Dog on the lead where boar live,** especially at dusk on forest paths. Dogs find them first and get hurt.
**Feeding is banned and can cost up to 5,000 euros.** Fed boar lose their fear and come back every night.
**Garden fence: about 1.50 m high, dug about 40 cm deep and bent outwards.** Compost inside it, bins closed.
**Danger, a boar in a building or a car crash: call 110.** For advice, the NABU wildlife line is 030 54712891.
